name: Cobb County, GA
findings: Cobb County has 3,386 nonprofit organizations. 1,247 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 958 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Cobb County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 292 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 292 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few union organizations list membership
observations.text: 3 union organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 9 would.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through union groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for civic or political action
observations.text: 5 social and fraternal organizations here list civic or political action, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.
